title: The Ceremonial Song
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with the [[Champion Festival Song]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW The Ceremonial Song.png }} |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Laruta]] |location= Zora's Domain |prereq= |reward= [[Dagah Keek Shrine]] |previous= "{{Color BotW|Main Quest|[[Divine Beast Vah Ruta (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Ruta]]}}" |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Ceremonial Song||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Ceremonial Song}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Zora's Domain}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== After [[Link]] has calmed [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]], he will find [[Laruta]] singing in front of [[Mipha's Statue]] in the [[Zora's Domain]] [[Zora's Domain Square|Square]].{{Cite|♪A light scale...♪|Laruta|BotW}} She continues to sing once Link approaches her,{{Cite|♪La dee dooo!♪
♪A gift from the sky...
a {{Color BotW|Red|scale of light}}...♪|Laruta|BotW}} but she is shocked when she recognizes him as the [[Hylian]] who helped [[Sidon]].{{Cite|Oh! You're the Hylian who helped our Prince Sidon! You're sooo handsome!|Laruta|BotW}} When Link asks about her singing, Laruta reveals that she was singing a song from the [[Champion Festival]] and asks if he would like to hear it.{{Cite|[That song?] I just looooove singing! I even remember the song from the Champion Festival! ...Do you want to hear it?|Laruta|BotW}} If Link agrees to listen, Laruta will sing the "[[Champion Festival Song]]" for him.{{Cite|[I want to hear it.] OK! I'm gonna sing it now! The Champion Festival Song!|Laruta|BotW}} The lyrics describe a scale of light splitting the feet at [[Veiled Falls]], which will reveal a trial.{{Cite|♪A gift from the sky...
a {{Color BotW|Red|scale of light}}...♪
♪Splits the feet...
of a {{Color BotW|Red|Veiled Falls}} sight...♪
♪Your {{Color BotW|Red|trial}} awaits...
It's glowing bright...♪|Laruta|BotW}} While she does not understand the "Champion Festival Song", Laruta plans on singing it until the next Champion Festival.{{Cite|I don't really get what the song's about, but I'm gonna sing it at the next Champion Festival!|Laruta|BotW}} Even though [[Trello]] is in charge of the Festival, Laruta has noticed that he has not done anything to prepare yet.{{Cite|Mr. Trello is supposed to get the festival together, but he hasn't done anything for it yet.|Laruta|BotW}} She wonders if he forgot that he was supposed to do so.{{Cite|I wonder what's wrong with him... Did he forget that's his job?|Laruta|BotW}} With this, the [[Shrine Quest]] begins. Trello can be found pacing on the western bridge out of Zora's Domain. He reveals that he needs to devise a plan to find the [[Ceremonial Trident]].{{Cite|Now then... I must devise a plan to find the {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}}...|Trello|BotW}} When Link asks, Trello tells him that it is used in the Champion Festival to honor [[Mipha]] in place of the actual [[Lightscale Trident]].{{Cite|[Ceremonial trident?] The {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}} is used in a festival to honor Champion Mipha... The Champion Festival's {{Color BotW|Blue|Lightscale Trident}}... Well, it's a fake.|Trello|BotW}} On the way to have the Ceremonial Trident examined by [[Dento]], Trello accidentally dropped it off the bridge.{{Cite|I planned to have that {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}} examined by Dento, but on the way there, I dropped it off the bridge.|Trello|BotW}} As it is a fake, Trello plans on asking Dento to make a new one for him.{{Cite|It doesn't really matter. It's a fake, after all... I'll have to ask Dento to make a new one.|Trello|BotW}} Should someone find the missing Ceremonial Trident, Trello will allow them to keep it.{{Cite|If someone happens to pick it up, they can just keep it.|Trello|BotW}} Link can retrieve the Ceremonial Trident by walking out onto the [[Water]] with [[Cryonis]]. Once he is in range, he will be able to lift it out with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. With the Ceremonial Trident, Link can jump off the stop of the Veiled Falls and strike the [[Pedestal]] in the Water, causing [[Dagah Keek Shrine]] to rise from the ground nearby, completing the Shrine Quest.{{Cite|You thrust the spear that Trello dropped into the pedestal hidden in Veiled Falls, causing an ancient shrine to appear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Laruta taught you the Zora song of the Champion ceremony.

"A gift from the sky: a scale of light
Splits the feet of a Veiled Falls sight.
Your trial awaits... It's glowing bright."

Trello seems to know more about the ceremony. |- | 2 | Laruta taught you the Zora song of the Champion ceremony.

"A gift from the sky: a scale of light
Splits the feet of a Veiled Falls sigh.
Your trial awaits... It's glowing bright."

Trello accidentally dropped the Ceremonial Trident used in the Champion ceremony off of the bridge. If you find the spear and re-create the actions from the song, a new trial may open. |- | Complete | You thrust the spear that Trello dropped into the pedestal hidden in Veiled Falls, causing an ancient shrine to appear. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Champion Festival Song.png|Laruta singing the "Champion Festival Song" File:BotW Dagah Keek Shrine.png|Dagah Keek Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Champion Festival Song * Dagah Keek Shrine * Laruta * Zora's Domain }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
